en: Current real-time Bitcoin price is $78063 with a 24-hour change of 1.87%, marking a decisive rebound above the psychological $78,000 threshold and signaling renewed bullish momentum across the broader crypto ecosystem. On-chain metrics show increased accumulation at the $77,500–$78,500 demand zone, while the recent breakout above the 50-day moving average suggests the correction phase from the $80,000 high may be concluding. Volume-weighted average price (VWAP) metrics indicate sustained buying pressure, particularly during intraday dips, reinforcing the notion that sellers are losing control. The Fear & Greed Index currently stands at 72, categorizing market sentiment as "Extreme Greed"—a level historically associated with short-term pullbacks but also the onset of parabolic phases if momentum holds. This reading aligns with the price action, as greed-driven FOMO often fuels final legs of bull runs, yet the underlying on-chain health—measured by realized cap growth and stablecoin inflows—suggests the rally may have further room to run before exhaustion sets in. Technically, the Relative Strength Index (RSI) on the 4-hour chart reads 68, placing Bitcoin in overbought territory but still within a bullish configuration above 60, which often precedes consolidation rather than immediate reversal. Key support levels are anchored at $76,800 (23.6% Fibonacci retracement of the recent swing low) and the stronger $75,200 zone holding the 100-day moving average. On the upside, immediate resistance emerges at $79,400 (daily pivot high), with a break above $80,500 exposing the next major supply cluster around $82,200–$83,000. A sustained hold above $78,000 with rising volume would validate the bullish thesis, while a dip below $76,500 with expanding sell-side pressure could trigger a deeper correction toward the $74,000–$75,000 support corridor.
